clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Furen Longbeard has a new armor design for an Alliance warrior. The dwarf armorer offers to forge Fire Hardened Mail if the warrior brings him rare materials from both continents.

Furen Longbeard has forged an exceptional buckler for the aspiring warrior and now proposes a greater work: mail made to withstand fierce blows. His craft calls for more than iron or steel. He needs rare materials touched by elemental heat and natural resilience. Furen cannot leave his Stormwind forge, so the warrior seeking the armor must gather these dangerous ingredients.

Furen sends the warrior to distant wilds and dangerous depths for the parts he needs. The recipe calls for fangs from venomous spiders in the damp crevices of the Wetlands, along with scorched and galvanized horns from fierce chimaeras in the Stonetalon Mountains. To bind and temper those beast parts into mail, Furen also needs volatile phlogiston from Roogug, a geomancer deep within Razorfen Kraul's thorny maze in the Barrens.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So I gave you a nice shield, but we don't have to stop there. I know the secrets to make extremely hard mail armor. It's not easy and it takes very rare materials, but if you're willing to do the legwork then I'll make a piece for you.
What do you say, friend? If you're up for the challenge, then I'll give you a list of what to get and where to get them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How goes the scavenger hunt, friend? Do you have the materials?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got it all? Amazing! I was afraid those chimaeras would eat you up for sure!
Well let's get started on that armor...
